name: Damian Kraus
source: An elite A+ technoob university student with 1 year of Sleep Delivery experience. He's more focused on his job than anything more, resulting in a sometimes frosty service he sticks to singing lullabies to help you sleep, though he admits his singing voice isn't the best.
